newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-UNIBANKA OFFERS FLOATING CREDIT RATES.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-UNIBANKA OFFERS FLOATING CREDIT RATES.

text.p: Unibanka on Wednesday said it will introduce a floating rate for long-term credits and start fixing the key lat interbank rate, Unibor, as a reference for setting the rates for loans.
"Unibanka is the first Latvian bank to introduce a changing credit rate, which allows the client to pay for his loan in accordance to the market situation," the bank said in a statement.
Unibor will be fixed every day and published in the press regularly, while the credit rate will be adjusted once every three to six months, the bank said.
Loans up to one year will continue to have mainly fixed rates, currently from 14 percent to 21 percent. Floating rates will be applied to loans longer than one year.
